**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Expire graph embeddings with their source events**

When event retention is configured, this write persists the normalized source text in `graphNodeEmbeddings` without an `expiresAt` value, and `openMongoDB` creates no TTL index for that collection. MongoDB can therefore delete the source and derived events while this text and its embedding remain indefinitely; propagate the source event's retention exemption/expiry to these rows and reconcile a corresponding TTL index.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject server-side JavaScript in projections**

When a raw browse request supplies a projection containing `$function`, this unchecked cast bypasses `assertSafeFilter`, which inspects only `body.filter`, and sends the expression to MongoDB. `find()` projections accept aggregation expressions, and `$function` executes server-side JavaScript by default ([MongoDB projection documentation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.find/), [$function` documentation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/function/)), so a caller can run expensive JavaScript despite this module explicitly rejecting those operators in filters; apply the same recursive validation to projections before accessing the collection.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

+(ns openplanner.graph.claims.core
+  "Pure edge-claim domain logic.
+
+  Boundary rule: this namespace accepts only normalized CLJS data. It does not
+  inspect JavaScript objects, parse Dates, hash bytes, or defensively guess at
+  external field names. All external coercion belongs in
+  openplanner.graph.claims.boundary."
+  (:require [clojure.string :as str]))
+
+(def statuses
+  #{:proposed
+    :supported
+    :active
+    :refuted
+    :rejected
+    :superseded
+    :expired
+    :withdrawn})
+
+(def projectable-statuses #{:supported :active})
+(def directions #{:directed :undirected})
+
+(defn normalize-status
+  [status fallback]
+  (if (contains? statuses status) status fallback))
+
+(defn normalize-direction
+  [direction]
+  (if (= direction :undirected) :undirected :directed))
+
+(defn canonical-endpoints
+  [{:keys [source-node-id target-node-id direction]}]
+  (if (and (= :undirected direction)
+           (neg? (compare target-node-id source-node-id)))
+    [target-node-id source-node-id]
+    [source-node-id target-node-id]))
+
+(defn claim-id-material
+  "Returns the canonical preimage for an edge claim ID. Hashing is a boundary
+  concern so pure CLJS remains host-independent."
+  [{:keys [relation-kind direction scope-json] :as claim-key}]
+  (let [[left right] (canonical-endpoints claim-key)]
+    (str left "\n" right "\n" relation-kind "\n" (name direction) "\n" (or scope-json "{}"))))
+
+(defn projectable?
+  [{:keys [status valid-until-ms]} {:keys [statuses include-expired? now-ms]}]
+  (let [accepted-statuses (or statuses projectable-statuses)
+        not-expired? (or include-expired?
+                         (nil? valid-until-ms)
+                         (> valid-until-ms now-ms))]
+    (and (contains? accepted-statuses status) not-expired?)))
+
+(defn claim->projected-edge
+  [{:keys [claim-id source-node-id target-node-id relation-kind direction scope status confidence] :as claim}
+   opts]
+  (when (projectable? claim opts)
+    {:source source-node-id
+     :target target-node-id

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Validate claims before projecting edges**

When a supported or active claim already supplies `claim_id` (as every Mongo row does through `_id` fallback), missing or self-referential endpoints bypass `build-edge-claim-id` validation, and this predicate checks only status and expiry. `projectEdgeClaim` and `projectMongoEdgeClaims` can consequently emit edges with `nil` endpoints or other schema-invalid fields, contradicting their declared output contract and potentially breaking graph consumers; require `valid-edge-claim?` before constructing the projection.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject negative memory-cache capacities**

When `createMemoryLruCache` receives a negative `maxEntries`, the first put enters this loop permanently: after the inserted entry is removed, the cache size is zero but `0 > max-entries` remains true, so subsequent iterations repeatedly attempt to remove a `nil` victim. Validate the public option as a non-negative integer before constructing the cache to prevent a configuration mistake from synchronously hanging the process.
